title: General
subtitle: 「一般的／廣泛的／整體的」，究竟是哪一種 general？
description: 「一般的／廣泛的／整體的」，究竟是哪一種 general？

words.note: 強調涵蓋範圍很大、內容跨度廣，而不是集中在狹窄細節。
words.example: The report gives a broad overview of the industry.
words.exampleZh: 報告提供該行業的廣泛概覽。

exercises.original: The course gives a general introduction to politics, economics, and history rather than focusing on one narrow subject.
exercises.zh: 課程廣泛介紹政治、經濟和歷史，而不是集中單一狹窄主題。

options.explanation: politics, economics, and history + contrast with one narrow subject shows scope is the decisive clue. Broad introduction naturally means wide-ranging rather than specialised.
overall evaluates the whole result or picture; it does not normally describe the range of subjects in an introduction.
widespread describes distribution or prevalence, such as widespread support, not curricular scope.
would mean applicable to all cases, which is much stronger than the sentence claims.
means representative or usual, not wide in scope.
is an adverb and cannot modify introduction as an adjective.

exercises.original: The committee considered the issue in general terms, covering social, economic, and environmental effects.
exercises.zh: 委員會從廣泛角度考慮問題，涵蓋社會、經濟和環境影響。

options.explanation: multiple dimensions are considered, so in broad terms is the standard scope-focused expression.
means not special, which says nothing about breadth of coverage.
distribution is not the issue.
would suggest non-specific or template-like wording, not necessarily wide scope.
too strong; the committee is not claiming all cases.
broadly can occur in other structures, but the fixed phrase here is in broad terms.

exercises.original: The survey asked general questions covering many aspects of daily life.
exercises.zh: 調查提出涵蓋日常生活多個方面的廣泛問題。

options.explanation: covering many aspects directly signals wide scope.
could describe an overall assessment, but not usually individual questions whose scope is wide.
means frequent, not wide-ranging.
would imply the same questions apply to everyone in every context.
means unexceptional.
is a noun, not an adjective.

words.note: 強調把各部分合在一起看時的整體結果、印象或情況。
words.example: The overall result was positive despite several minor problems.
words.exampleZh: 儘管有幾個小問題，整體結果仍然正面。

exercises.original: The general result was positive, although two departments performed poorly.
exercises.zh: 儘管兩個部門表現欠佳，整體結果仍然正面。

options.explanation: the sentence combines mixed component results into one total judgement. Overall result is the standard collocation.
would describe scope, not aggregate performance.
would imply the positive result was distributed across many places/people, not simply the combined result.
means non-specific.
means frequent.
not standard English; overall itself can function adjectivally or adverbially.

exercises.original: The general picture is encouraging despite several areas of concern.
exercises.zh: 儘管有幾個值得關注的範疇，整體情況仍令人鼓舞。

options.explanation: despite several areas of concern means the sentence is summing up all parts into one whole picture.
broad picture can mean a high-level overview, but here the key contrast is total evaluation despite mixed details, so overall is more precise.
distribution is not the focus.
means representative.
means not special.
far too strong.

exercises.original: Customer satisfaction was general high even though delivery times varied.
exercises.zh: 儘管送貨時間不一，整體顧客滿意度仍然很高。

options.explanation: the sentence reports an aggregate measure across customers, making overall customer satisfaction idiomatic.
an adverb cannot directly replace the adjective before customer satisfaction here.
would mean satisfaction existed among many people, but not necessarily refer to the aggregate score.
not a natural collocation with satisfaction in this sense.
non-specific, not aggregate.
incorrect spelling; wholly means completely and would still not fit this structure.

words.meaning: 廣泛存在的；普遍流行的
words.note: 表示某事在很多地方、人群或情況中大量存在或分布很廣。
words.exampleZh: 這項改變獲得廣泛支持。

exercises.original: The proposal received general support across most regions and age groups.
exercises.zh: 這項提案在大多數地區和年齡組別都獲得廣泛支持。
exercises.upgrade: widespread · 廣泛存在的；普遍流行的

options.explanation: across most regions and age groups explicitly describes broad distribution of support.
could summarize total support level, but does not highlight distribution across groups.
broad support is also natural and close, but widespread more directly matches the across-regions prevalence clue.
means representative.
means non-specific.
means virtually everyone/everywhere, stronger than most regions and age groups.

exercises.original: There is general concern about the shortage throughout the country.
exercises.zh: 全國各地都普遍關注這次短缺。

options.explanation: throughout the country indicates prevalence across many places.
would refer to a combined assessment, not geographical distribution.
means normal/commonplace, not widely shared.
not specific.
representative, not widespread.
adverb and wrong meaning.

exercises.original: The technology is now in general use across schools, hospitals, and businesses.
exercises.zh: 這項科技現在已在學校、醫院和企業中廣泛使用。

options.explanation: the fixed collocation in widespread use expresses use across many sectors.
not idiomatic as in overall use.
means normal, not broadly distributed.
could describe a non-branded technology but not prevalence.
not a usage-distribution term.
would imply use everywhere or by everyone, stronger than the evidence.

words.note: 表示從多個具體情況中抽取出一般模式，或不針對單一具體例子。
words.example: The article offers a generalised account rather than a case-by-case analysis.
words.exampleZh: 文章提供概括性的說明，而不是逐案分析。

exercises.original: The article gives a general account of the problem rather than examining individual cases.
exercises.zh: 文章對問題作概括性說明，而不是逐一分析個案。
exercises.upgrade: generalised · 概括化的；一般化的

options.explanation: rather than examining individual cases shows information has been abstracted into a broader account.
often implies thorough coverage of details, which conflicts with the contrast against case-by-case analysis.
distribution is irrelevant.
would mean true for all cases, which the article does not claim.
not special, not abstracted.
adverb, cannot modify account directly.

exercises.original: The model provides a general description that applies across many examples.
exercises.zh: 模型提供適用於多個例子的概括描述。

options.explanation: the description abstracts across multiple examples rather than describing one specific case.
opposite.
would describe where the description is found, not its level of abstraction.
does not capture abstraction.
could summarize a whole, but not necessarily generalise across examples.
noun, while description needs an adjective.

exercises.original: The conclusion is deliberately general because the data come from many different settings.
exercises.zh: 由於數據來自很多不同環境，結論刻意寫得較概括。

options.explanation: many settings + deliberately broad conclusion indicates abstraction across contexts.
would claim validity in every case, which is too strong.
means thorough, not abstracted.
distribution of the conclusion is not the point.
not special, wrong nuance.
present participle would describe an action/process, not the resulting conclusion as cleanly.

words.note: 指設計來處理多種普通用途，而不是為某個特定專門任務而設。
words.example: This is a general-purpose tool rather than a specialist instrument.
words.exampleZh: 這是一件通用工具，而不是專門儀器。

exercises.original: This is a general tool designed for many everyday tasks rather than one specialist function.
exercises.zh: 這是一件適合多種日常任務的通用工具，而不是只有一項專門功能。
exercises.upgrade: general-purpose · 通用的；一般用途的

options.explanation: many everyday tasks + contrast with one specialist function directly defines a general-purpose tool.
would describe how common the tool is, not what it is designed to do.
not a functional design label.
too strong; the tool need not work for every imaginable task.
would mean unremarkable, not multi-purpose.
not the established compound adjective.

exercises.original: The software is general and can handle documents, spreadsheets, and presentations.
exercises.zh: 這套軟件屬通用型，可處理文件、試算表和簡報。

options.explanation: multiple functions rather than one specialised task make this a functional-use category.
says many people use it, not that it has many purposes.
not a standard term and would refer to branding.
not suitable here.
means representative.
not idiomatic.

exercises.original: The laboratory keeps a general computer for routine tasks and a separate specialist machine for imaging.
exercises.zh: 實驗室有一部通用電腦處理日常任務，另有一部專門影像電腦。

options.explanation: routine tasks vs specialist imaging machine is a direct general-purpose/special-purpose contrast.
not about prevalence.
appearance is irrelevant.
too strong.
not a device category.
could mean non-branded or non-specific, but does not necessarily mean multi-purpose.

words.note: 表示某事很常出現或很多人都遇到，但不一定指範圍「廣」。
words.example: This is a common problem among new users.
words.exampleZh: 這是新用戶中常見的問題。

exercises.original: This is a general mistake among people using the software for the first time.
exercises.zh: 這是首次使用該軟件的人常見的錯誤。

options.explanation: the sentence is about frequency among new users, so common mistake is the standard collocation.
a mistake is not “wide in scope” here.
does not express frequency.
would imply nearly every new user makes it, too strong.
could mean non-specific, not frequent.
adverb; adjective required before mistake.

exercises.original: Headaches are a general complaint after this type of treatment.
exercises.zh: 頭痛是這類治療後常見的症狀／投訴。

options.explanation: common complaint is a frequent-occurrence collocation in health contexts.
does not describe how often a symptom occurs.
scope is irrelevant.
would mean non-specific.
would imply everyone experiences headaches, unsupported.
adverb, not adjective.

exercises.original: Delays are general during the winter because of bad weather.
exercises.zh: 冬季因惡劣天氣而出現延誤是很常見的。

options.explanation: the statement concerns how frequently delays happen.
not a frequency adjective.
not about scope.
would mean delays always/everywhere occur, too strong.
wrong meaning.
noun.

words.note: 表示具有某一類事物常見的特徵，可用來代表一般情況。
words.example: A typical working day begins at eight.
words.exampleZh: 一般典型工作日八時開始。

exercises.original: A general day in the role begins with a team meeting and ends with client calls.
exercises.zh: 這份工作的典型一天由團隊會議開始，以客戶電話結束。
exercises.upgrade: typical · 典型的；一般常見的

options.explanation: the sentence gives a representative example of what an ordinary working day is like.
days are not distributed across places in this sense.
not representative-example meaning.
could mean non-specific, but a typical day specifically means representative of the usual pattern.
too strong; not every day must be identical.
adverb, not adjective.

exercises.original: The general customer spends about twenty minutes in the store.
exercises.zh: 一般典型顧客在店內停留約二十分鐘。

options.explanation: the sentence describes a representative customer pattern, not every single customer.
cannot naturally modify customer this way.
not about distribution.
would suggest all customers behave identically.
could mean unspecified customer, not statistically representative one.
noun, not adjective.

exercises.original: This reaction is general of people encountering the system for the first time.
exercises.zh: 這種反應很典型地出現在首次接觸該系統的人身上。

options.explanation: the fixed collocation is typical of, meaning representative of a group.
does not take this of structure.
scope is not the issue.
could describe how common the reaction is, but the grammar and representative-group meaning specifically call for typical of.
too strong.
adverb cannot follow is as the subject complement here.

words.note: 表示不特別、不特殊，屬於日常或正常範圍。
words.example: The device looks like an ordinary household appliance.
words.exampleZh: 這部裝置看起來像普通家用電器。

exercises.original: At first glance, the device looks like a general household appliance.
exercises.zh: 乍看之下，這部裝置看起來像普通家用電器。

options.explanation: the meaning is “not unusual or special”, a standard ordinary household appliance collocation.
would describe how widely the appliance exists, not its ordinary appearance/type.
not a category adjective here.
would mean applicable everywhere.
means thorough/complete, inappropriate.
adverb, not adjective.

exercises.original: The service is designed for general users rather than specialists.
exercises.zh: 這項服務是為一般用戶而設，而不是專家。

options.explanation: the contrast is non-specialist vs specialist; ordinary users means everyday users without specialist expertise.
cannot describe user type.
would mean many users, not non-specialist users.
would imply every possible user.
could mean non-specific user persona, but not naturally “non-specialist people” here.
adverb.

exercises.original: Nothing about the building looked unusual; it seemed completely general from the outside.
exercises.zh: 這棟建築外觀看起來沒有甚麼特別，完全很普通。

options.explanation: nothing unusual is the decisive semantic clue: ordinary means unexceptional.
not about physical scope.
not an appearance adjective of this kind.
distribution irrelevant.
wrong meaning.
noun, while complement after seemed should be adjective.

words.meaning: 通用的；非特定品牌／類別的；概括性的
words.note: 表示不具體指向某個特定品牌、個體或專門類型。
words.example: The form uses generic labels rather than brand names.
words.exampleZh: 表格使用通用標籤，而不是品牌名稱。

exercises.original: The document uses general labels instead of company-specific product names.
exercises.zh: 文件使用通用標籤，而不是公司特定產品名稱。

options.explanation: contrast with company-specific product names directly signals non-brand-specific labels.
not about specificity.
not about prevalence.
unremarkable, not necessarily non-specific.
all-applicable, stronger and different.
adverb, but labels needs an adjective.

exercises.original: The template contains general wording that can be adapted for many organisations.
exercises.zh: 模板包含可供多個機構修改使用的通用措辭。
exercises.upgrade: generic · 概括性的；非特定的

options.explanation: a reusable template deliberately avoids organisation-specific detail, making generic wording exact.
does not mean reusable/non-specific.
describes distribution.
representative, not necessarily adaptable.
thorough coverage is not the key.
noun, not adjective.

exercises.original: The pharmacy offers a general version of the medicine rather than only the branded product.
exercises.zh: 藥房除了品牌藥，也提供非品牌的通用版本。

options.explanation: rather than the branded product is the decisive clue: generic medicine is non-brand-specific.
not a product category.
does not mean non-brand medicine.
not about prevalence.
not relevant.
nonstandard here; use generic.

words.note: 表示某措施、改變或影響涵蓋所有類別、部門或群組。
words.example: The company announced across-the-board price reductions.

exercises.original: The company announced a general pay increase for every department.
exercises.zh: 公司宣布所有部門一律加薪。
exercises.upgrade: across-the-board · 全面的；一律適用的

options.explanation: for every department shows the measure applies uniformly across categories.
would mean the increase occurs in many places, not necessarily all departments by policy.
summarises totals rather than applying a rule to everyone.
not policy coverage.
not specific, not comprehensive.
adverb; the sentence needs an attributive adjective phrase before pay increase.

exercises.original: Management introduced general cuts affecting all divisions equally.
exercises.zh: 管理層實施全面削減，所有部門同樣受影響。

options.explanation: all divisions equally is the defining clue for uniform application.
could mean large scope, but not necessarily equal application to all divisions.
wrong meaning.
not special, wrong nuance.
non-specific, not uniform policy.
could describe total cuts but not the rule applying to every division.

exercises.original: The policy makes a general reduction in fees for every category of applicant.
exercises.zh: 政策對所有類別申請人一律減費。

options.explanation: every category means the reduction applies across all categories.
describes aggregate effect, not uniform application.
many categories is weaker than every category.
not specific, wrong meaning.
representative, not comprehensive application.
could mean broad coverage, but doesn't specifically encode equal application to every category.

words.meaning: 普遍適用的；全體共有的
words.note: 表示對所有人、所有情況或整個類別都成立，語義比 general 更強。
words.example: There is no universal solution to the problem.
words.exampleZh: 這個問題沒有一個普遍適用於所有情況的解決方法。

exercises.original: There is no general solution that works in every possible case.
exercises.zh: 沒有一個能適用於所有可能情況的普遍解決方案。
exercises.upgrade: universal · 普遍適用的；全體共有的

options.explanation: every possible case is the decisive clue. Universal means applicable without exception or nearly so.
wide scope still allows exceptions.
aggregate evaluation, not all-case applicability.
widely found does not mean valid in every case.
representative, not universal.
adverb; adjective needed before solution.

exercises.original: The researchers found no general pattern shared by every group.
exercises.zh: 研究人員沒有找到所有群組都共同具有的普遍模式。

options.explanation: shared by every group requires the strongest all-groups meaning.
a common pattern may appear frequently but not in every group.
also allows exceptions.
not an applicability term.
non-specific, wrong meaning.
noun.

exercises.original: The desire for safety is often described as a general human concern found across all societies.
exercises.zh: 對安全的需求常被形容為所有社會都共有的人類普遍關切。

options.explanation: across all societies explicitly signals all-human applicability.
wide but not all-encompassing.
representative but not necessarily shared by all.
not specific, wrong nuance.
not natural with human concern here.
adverb, not adjective.

words.note: 表示包含很多方面、資訊或細節，重點是完整性而非只是概括。
words.example: The review provides a comprehensive assessment of the programme.
words.exampleZh: 評估對該計劃作出全面分析。

exercises.original: The report provides a general review covering every major aspect in detail.
exercises.zh: 報告對所有主要方面作出詳細全面評估。

options.explanation: every major aspect in detail combines breadth and thoroughness, which is the hallmark of comprehensive coverage.
wide scope, but it can still be high-level and non-detailed.
distribution irrelevant.
representativeness irrelevant.
non-specific, opposite of detailed.
adverb, but review needs an adjective.

exercises.original: The guide gives a general explanation of the system, including setup, troubleshooting, security, and maintenance.
exercises.zh: 指南全面說明系統，包括設定、故障排除、安全和維護。

options.explanation: multiple major areas are all included, indicating thorough coverage.
would suggest non-specific content, not full coverage.
not special, wrong meaning.
not about distribution.
not representative example.
noun.

exercises.original: The assessment is more than a general check; it examines performance, safety, cost, and reliability.
exercises.zh: 這項評估不只是一般檢查，而是全面檢視性能、安全、成本和可靠性。

options.explanation: the explicit multi-factor, detailed scope is the key.
would weaken the meaning.
not about distribution.
not about representative pattern.
opposite of detailed specificity.
could describe an aggregate assessment, but does not guarantee detailed coverage of all listed dimensions.

words.note: 當 general 用來表示「不深入細節的整體說明」時，這個短語非常自然。
words.example: The first chapter gives a general overview of the topic.
words.exampleZh: 第一章提供主題的整體概覽。

exercises.original: The first chapter gives a general introduction to the subject before later chapters examine the details.
exercises.zh: 第一章先提供主題的整體概覽，之後章節才深入細節。
exercises.upgrade: general overview · 整體概覽；概括介紹

options.explanation: before later chapters examine the details explicitly signals an introductory, high-level summary.
would imply detailed, thorough examination, contrary to the sequencing.
not idiomatic; accounts are not “widespread” in this sense.
different semantic category.
not a summary.
not standard English.

exercises.original: The presentation begins with a general summary of the project and then moves into technical details.
exercises.zh: 簡報先作項目的整體概覽，再進入技術細節。

options.explanation: high-level first, details later is the defining structure.
would already include the details.
unrelated.
not idiomatic.
wrong category.
not natural in this structure.

exercises.original: The guide gives readers a general picture of the process without explaining every stage in depth.
exercises.zh: 指南提供流程的整體概述，但不深入解釋每個階段。

options.explanation: without explaining every stage in depth is the decisive clue: overview is intentionally high-level.
would suggest fuller detail.
all-case applicability is not the issue.
distribution meaning does not fit.
could be understandable, but general overview is the standard pedagogical phrase.
wrong syntax.

words.note: 副詞片語，用來概括大多數情況，而不是逐一列舉例外。
words.example: In general, customers prefer simpler interfaces.
words.exampleZh: 一般而言，顧客偏好較簡單的介面。

exercises.original: General customers prefer a simpler interface, although there are exceptions.
exercises.zh: 一般而言，顧客偏好較簡單的介面，但也有例外。
exercises.upgrade: In general · 一般而言；總的來說

options.explanation: although there are exceptions shows a broad tendency rather than a universal rule. In general is the standard sentence adverbial.
would imply no exceptions, directly contradicting the sentence.
means thoroughly, not generally speaking.
rare/nonstandard in this meaning.
grammatically awkward and semantically contradictory.
not standard; use overall or in general.

exercises.original: General, people adapt quickly to the new system once they have used it a few times.
exercises.zh: 一般來說，人們使用新系統幾次後便能很快適應。

options.explanation: the sentence states a broad tendency across people, not an adjective modifying a noun.
is an adjective and would require a noun.
also adjective, not sentence adverbial.
adjective; cannot stand alone before the comma this way.
wrong meaning and word class.
noun, not a sentence connector.

exercises.original: The service is general reliable, despite occasional delays at peak times.
exercises.zh: 總的來說，這項服務可靠，儘管繁忙時段偶有延誤。

options.explanation: occasional exceptions are explicitly allowed, so this sentence-level qualifier is appropriate.
adjective and too strong.
distribution-focused.
non-specific, wrong meaning.
would describe the service as unexceptional, not summarize reliability.
adjective; the sentence needs the adverbial phrase in general.

falseSynonyms.zh: broad 常與 range、overview、category、support 等搭配，重點是涵蓋面廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The report gives a general introduction. The report covers a broad range of topics.

falseSynonyms.zh: overall 把各部分加總後看整體，不等於「一般、非專門」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This is a general guide for new users. The overall result was better than expected.

falseSynonyms.zh: widespread 常修飾 support、use、concern、damage 等，表示很多地方／人都有。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The report discusses the general situation. There is widespread concern about the issue.

falseSynonyms.zh: 某問題可以很 common，但你不會因此叫它 a general problem in every context。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This is a general principle. This is a common mistake.

falseSynonyms.zh: universal 幾乎表示所有情況都成立，而 general 通常允許例外。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON As a general rule, arrive early. There is no universal rule that works in every case.

falseSynonyms.zh: general 常表示概括、不深入細節；comprehensive 表示覆蓋全面而且往往很完整。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The booklet gives a general introduction. The manual provides a comprehensive explanation.

falseSynonyms.zh: generic 常指名稱、產品、模板或描述沒有具體品牌／個體特徵。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We need a general discussion of the issue. The package uses a generic product name.

falseSynonyms.zh: general 是形容詞或名詞；generally 是副詞「一般而言／通常」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We need a general explanation. Generally, the system works well.
